content:
Late Saturday night, just over 2 weeks ago, I got a call about some kittens found abandoned in a garbage bin. Thanks to a team of volunteers, they were transported and arrived to me just before midnight, skin & bones, absolutely covered in fleas, and so dehydrated that their urine was orange. The biggest one was only 155g, but eyes fully open, so likely 10-14 days old. Thanks to some flea baths, antiparasitic meds, tube feeding, and of course, love & warmth, they're now all thriving and getting ready to start weaning!

#FosterKittens #BottleBabies #AdoptDontShop #RatCityRescue #Kittens #IllegallySmolCats #Caturday

The biggest one was only 155g, but eyes fully open, so likely 10-14 days old. Thanks to some flea baths, antiparasitic meds, tube feeding, and of course, love & warmth, they're now all thriving and getting ready to start weaning!
